📺 Bodyguard (2018)

Bodyguard follows David Budd, a troubled war veteran working as a police protection officer in London who is assigned to protect Julia Montague, a powerful and controversial British Home Secretary. Despite his professional responsibilities, David strongly disagrees with Julia’s political views, creating tension as he struggles to keep her safe from increasingly dangerous threats. As their relationship becomes more complicated, David finds himself caught in a deadly conspiracy involving terrorism, government secrets, political corruption, and powerful individuals who cannot be trusted. Haunted by his experiences in Afghanistan, he must confront his personal struggles while trying to uncover the truth behind a series of shocking events. Starring Richard Madden and Keeley Hawes, the series delivers gripping suspense, unexpected betrayals, intense action, and psychological drama while exploring loyalty, trauma, trust, and the dangerous world of political power.

🎭 Genre: Thriller • Crime • Drama • Political Thriller

⭐ IMDb: 8.0/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 57–75 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creator: Jed Mercurio

📺 Seasons: 1 • 6 Episodes

🏆 Awards: Richard Madden won the Golden Globe Award for Best Actor in a Television Series – Drama.

📺 Where to Watch: Netflix in the United States.
